baseline.checkout_validation_behavior: server recalculates product/variant, stock and price; does not reserve inventario or create ERP order
baseline.payment_auth: Authorize + tenant scope + RBAC; initiation requires Idempotency-Key and stores opaque provider references only

in_scope: reuse existing Tienda public boundary rather than create a parallel store API
define ecommerce domain/contracts around server-authoritative catalog, price, stock, order and payment linkage
provide a safe public order/checkout transition without exposing internal ERP mutation endpoints
keep stock authority synchronized from existing inventario sources and prevent oversell/stale acceptance
preserve idempotency across order/payment creation and replay paths
tenant-isolate public catalog/order context without trusting client-supplied tenant identity
integrate existing PagoOnline flow without PAN/CVV storage
add frontend storefront only in the dedicated FRONTEND_UX stage

risks: cross-tenant data exposure through anonymous store endpoints
client-controlled price, totals, stock or tenant identifiers
duplicate/replayed public order and payment requests
public mutation path bypassing ERP RBAC/invariants
payment checkout/provider authenticity and replay boundary
divergence between storefront stock and ExistenciaVariante authority
acceptance_strategy: public catalog exposes only intended active product data
tenant resolution is server-authoritative and fail-closed
stock and price are recomputed server-side at checkout/order transition
order/payment mutations are idempotent and reuse existing domain authorities
no PAN/CVV or raw payment credentials are accepted/persisted
directed tests cover tenant isolation, stale stock, price tampering, replay/idempotency and payment boundary
causal CI only after material stages introduce product delta
rollback: N7.9.A is review/evidence only; rollback is not applicable. Later implementation stages must remain revertible without production/deploy changes from this parent.
